title: WIPO PCT & US/EU Botanical Drug Regulatory Comparison Framework

sections.section: US FDA Botanical Drug Development vs EU Herbal Medicinal Products Directive
sections.content: In the United States, Ayurvedic complex mixtures are regulated as Botanical Drugs (NDA pathway requiring batch-to-batch chemical fingerprinting) or Dietary Supplements (DSHEA 1994). In the European Union, traditional herbal products follow the Traditional Herbal Medicinal Products Directive (THMPD 2004/24/EC) requiring 30 years of traditional use (15 years within EU).
